$comment: GENERATED by .bin/se-mcp --tools > util/cage/tools.json. Edit src/mcp/lane.go, not this file.

tools.description: START THE ENGINE, and build it first if this tree carries none. Every other tool here asks the engine, so this is the one to call when they answer that it is not running. Calling it twice starts nothing twice.

wait.description: seconds to wait for it to answer, 0 for the default

tools.name: se_start

tools.description: TEST WHAT YOU CHANGED, naming the token: on: <id>.

plan.description: say what would run, run nothing

tools.name: se_test

tools.description: TAKE A BLOCK OF WORK so no other box starts it: next: <n>, or these: [ids]. It publishes to git by itself, and list says what is claimed.

next.description: claim what the queue would hand you on this many pulls

no_publish.description: write the claim here and leave git alone

sync.description: look for other boxes' claims now, rather than waiting for the engine's clock

take.description: with these, and one id: take that token up as well, so a refused agent needs one call and not two

tools.name: se_claim

tools.description: SEARCH THE TREE THROUGH THE INDEX: words (FTS5), regex, or path (a glob; alone it lists files).

archive.description: search what has been archived rather than the tree

tools.name: se_find

tools.description: ASK THE INDEX: sql, read-only; schema prints the tables.
tools.name: se_ask

tools.description: CHANGE FILES, naming the token: on: <id>. op: left off (replace old, exactly once, with new), create, write. undo puts back what that token wrote, and never another agent's work.
tools.name: se_apply

tools.description: RUN A SHELL COMMAND in the work folder, naming the token: on: <id>. A long output pages with page and from.
tools.name: se_run

tools.description: MINT A WORK TOKEN: title (four words at most), detail, done_when, and tracked, which says where it is born. tracked true puts it in doc/work, which git carries, so another agent on another box can claim it. tracked false keeps it in .se/work, for small work you do yourself next. A note takes neither and is always private. Or on: <id> takes that token into your hands, and put_down: <id> sets it back without closing it. Or abort: <id> with why ends it where it stands, and disposition became names in successors what it became.

abort.description: instead of minting: end this token, by id, with why

approach.description: the shape the work will take, written before the work. A process that requires one refuses a mint without it

bucket.description: the person's name for a group, which the queue can be narrowed to. Unsaid takes the bucket of the token in your hands

disposition.description: with abort: how it ends, one the process declares (default: dropped)

needs_human.description: true when the answer is not yours: your best attempt, and a person reads it first

put_down.description: instead of minting: set a token you hold back, by id, without closing it

successors.description: with abort and became: the ids it became

why.description: with abort: why it is ending. An abort with no reason is refused

tools.name: se_work

tools.description: NAME WHY YOU ARE STOPPING, when a stop was refused. No arguments reads the list.

list.description: print what is sanctioned, and claim nothing

tools.name: se_stop

tools.description: PULL FOR WORK; act on work, refused or wait. Submit with id and disposition, the checklist answered on the note.

role.description: worker, or reviewer for verdicts owed

tools.name: se_pull

tools.description: What the engine knows: the two roots, the log it is writing, and the rules in force. It also answers the state of play: what is open, what is held, and what this session returned with how much of it was wrong.
tools.name: se_status

tools.description: ANSWER THE PERSON, IN THE RECORD: the whole answer, for every prompt. Then keep working.

answer.description: what you would have said to them. The whole answer, not a summary of it.

tools.name: se_answer

tools.description: PUT WHAT THE PERSON SAID IN THE RECORD, WORD FOR WORD, when the engine has not already copied it. Copy their sentence. Do not shorten it, tidy it or join two of them.

said.description: what they said, copied. Their words and nothing else.

tools.name: se_said
